headline: Names a post office building in Howell, Michigan after Sergeant Donald Burgett.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 325 South Michigan Avenue in Howell, Michigan, as the "Sergeant Donald Burgett Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
